title: House of Hush
longDescription: House of Hush is a sleepwear and loungewear brand with a bold, feminine attitude. Sada developed a fashion-led visual identity centered on an elegant calligraphic wordmark and monogram, paired with a rich palette of burgundy, blush pink, cream, and soft blue. Repeated script patterns, tactile fabric applications, garment tags, and intimate editorial photography extend the identity across every touchpoint, balancing the softness of comfort with a confident and distinctive visual presence.
seoTitle: House of Hush Branding & Art Direction | Sada Studio
seoDescription: A fashion-led visual identity and art direction for a bold, feminine sleepwear and loungewear brand.

title: Marsa Inn
description: Seaside Seafood Restaurant & Guesthouse in Lebanon
longDescription: Marsa Inn is a refined seaside destination in Lebanon, bringing together a seafood restaurant and intimate guest rooms by the beach. Sada developed a visual identity inspired by the textures, colors, and character of the Mediterranean, balancing deep sea blues and warm neutrals with a bold wordmark, playful marine iconography, and a bilingual typographic system. Extended across menus, hospitality touchpoints, and a grainy direct-flash photography direction, the identity positions Marsa Inn as an elevated coastal escape for dining, staying, and slowing down.
seoDescription: A Mediterranean-inspired identity for a seaside seafood restaurant and guesthouse in Lebanon.

title: Throfee
longDescription: Throfee is a concept café where coffee, clothing, and conversation come together. Sada developed a bold visual identity that moves between hospitality and streetwear, combining an energetic orange-led palette, distinctive typography, and a modular system of minimal illustrations inspired by café rituals and fashion. Extended across menus, merchandise, posters, and other brand touchpoints, the identity gives Throfee a youthful presence that feels less like a traditional café and more like a culture of its own.
seoDescription: A bold brand identity and illustration system for a concept café blending coffee, clothing, and streetwear culture.

title: Presstine
longDescription: Presstine is an online shop offering custom and ready-made stamps through a distinctly Lebanese lens. Sada built the brand from the ground up, developing its logo, color palette, typography, graphic style, and photography direction. The logo draws on the fig “tine” in Arabic embedded within the brand’s name. Bright colors, youthful compositions, and intentionally imperfect details give the identity a tactile, handmade quality that reflects the unique irregularities and character of stamped impressions.
seoTitle: Presstine Branding & Art Direction | Sada Studio
seoDescription: A youthful, tactile visual identity and art direction for a Lebanese custom and ready-made stamp brand.

title: Ideal Mena
description: Consulting Company based in Lebanon and Iraq
longDescription: IDEAL MENA is a regional consulting firm that designs systems for long-term performance and impact — operating at the intersection of strategy, humanity, and technology to help governments, enterprises, and institutions build what endures. The brand uplift retained the existing logo while transforming the entire identity around it, introducing a modern, future-facing system defined by a refined palette, crisp typography, and a glass-like visual language built on translucency, blur, and depth. From stationery and corporate applications to social media and brand design, the refreshed identity positions IDEAL MENA as precise, resilient, and quietly confident in complex environments.
seoDescription: A contemporary brand identity for a regional consulting company.

title: Takawin
longDescription: Takawin is a perfume brand that translates astrology into scent — crafting fragrances inspired by horoscopes and personal archetypes, where each blend feels like a signature aligned with the stars. The brand identity was built from the ground up, from logo creation to typographic direction, establishing a distinctive visual world that feels mystical yet modern. From the refined type system to the packaging design, every touchpoint was crafted to turn each perfume into a collectible ritual — expressive, intentional, and made to feel personal.

title: M FIT
longDescription: For M FIT, a personal training brand, Sada developed the logo, visual identity, and social media direction. The logo pairs a fluid, organic “M,” inspired by the movement and curves of the human form, with a bold, structured “FIT” that represents discipline and strength. Its forward-leaning italic construction introduces a sense of speed, momentum, and progress. Together, these contrasting elements create a dynamic identity that balances freedom of movement with the commitment behind training.
seoTitle: M FIT Branding & Social Media | Sada Studio
seoDescription: A dynamic visual identity and social media direction for a personal training and fitness brand.

title: Zanzibar Investment Summit
longDescription: For the Zanzibar Investment Summit, Sada developed a complete visual identity rooted in the island’s cultural heritage. The logo draws inspiration from the intricately carved doors of Zanzibar’s historic old city, translating their ornamental forms into a contemporary symbol that also incorporates the letters “ZIS.” A culturally inspired color palette and supporting visual direction extend this concept across the summit’s communications, creating an identity that feels distinctive, relevant, and unmistakably connected to Zanzibar.
seoTitle: Zanzibar Investment Summit Branding | Sada Studio
seoDescription: A culturally inspired event identity for the Zanzibar Investment Summit, rooted in the island’s heritage.

title: The Super Power Father
longDescription: The Super Power Father is a workshop designed to help fathers approach parenting with greater confidence and connection. Sada developed a warm, energetic visual identity built around a bold color palette, expressive typography, playful graphics, and a relatable photography style. We then extended the identity across the full workshop experience, creating an interactive booklet with exercises designed to be cut out and used as activity cards, alongside a cohesive presentation deck to guide each session.
seoTitle: The Super Power Father Branding | Sada Studio
seoDescription: A warm, energetic workshop identity with interactive editorial materials and presentation design for fathers.

title: C Cater
longDescription: C Cater is a catering company built around fresh, elevated everyday moments — bringing people together through food that feels both generous and refined. The social media direction was crafted as a bright, minimal lifestyle system, balancing clean layouts with warm, appetizing imagery and plenty of breathing space. From story templates to grid design and content styling, the visual language keeps the brand modern, upbeat, and instantly recognizable across every post.

title: Karaj
longDescription: Karaj is a Lebanon-based platform that connects drivers with nearby garages — making it faster and easier to find trusted automotive help and streamlining the link between workshops and customers. The brand identity was developed end-to-end with a minimal, performance-driven approach inspired by McLaren and the automotive world. From the logo and visual language to key brand applications, Karaj was shaped to feel precise, premium, and engineered for motion.
